name: BT Group plc
executive_summary:
The BT Group (BT-A.L) memo is in `docs/data/research_director_worker/BT-A.L/20260904T201714Z/director_memo.md`.

**Verdict: accumulate · Risk: high · Confidence: 0.62**

The screen Buy (6/22, 5-week persistent) is not endorsed. Companies House FY26 normalised FCF of **£1.5bn** covers Yahoo cash dividends of **£807m** and the **£126m** buyback, and adjusted EBITDA held at **£8.2bn**. That is not enough for a Buy.

Three FCF figures remain unreconciled: company NFCF **£1.5bn**, Yahoo OCF−capex **£1,861m** (the 9.3% yield), and suppressed TTM **£1,200.4m**. Both assigned CH extracts stop in the strategic-report front matter. The 22 July trading statement and 29 June Verizon JV are headline-only. Yahoo net debt of **£18.3bn** is ex-lease; add leases (**£4.2bn**) and the pension line (**£4.4bn**) and economic leverage is not comfortable. Neff PEGY passed at **0.05** while printed growth is **−9.0%**. Summary limits of **£197.50 / £193.14** are pence labelled as pounds.

Watch the ingested July TU / next H1, JV close, Openreach harvest versus Ofcom, BTPS/gilt refinancing, and Bharti/NSI ownership before any upgrade from accumulate.

open_questions: Which free-cash figure is usable for FCF Yield (9.3%) and the dividend-family pass: Yahoo/filing-aligned FY2026 FCF 1,861m (OCF 7,030m − capex 5,169m) versus screen TTM 1,200.4m with TTM cashflow suppressed because quarterly_cashflow is empty — and can the FY26 cash dividend (Yahoo 807m) plus buybacks (Yahoo repurchase 126m) be funded on the conservative TTM basis after FCF already fell 2,052m → 1,861m while capex rose to 5,169m?

The catalog has period=interim 0. The only tagged trading_update is a 18 Feb 2025 Google News ‘Across The Markets: Hollywood Bowl, BT Group, Castings’ wrap, not a BT operating print. News then records a 22 Jul 2026 REG Trading Statement and a 29 Jun Verizon international-connectivity JV that have no filing bodies. Can a Buy be endorsed from the 30 Jul 2026 Companies House FY26 group accounts alone, or must trade wait on an ingested Q1 FY27 TU / H1 statutory (typical November window) and JV perimeter numbers?

Revenue fell two years running (Yahoo 20,797m → 20,358m → 19,654m) with growth printed at −9.0% while Neff PEGY passed at 0.05. Does screen P/E 18.5 / P/B 1.6 / FCF yield 9.3% already price an Openreach fibre-to-harvest handoff (‘end of the great fibre dig’), or a structural Consumer/EE plus wholesale share-loss story that the PEGY multiple does not survive once altnet/Virgin/Vodafone competition and any Ofcom Openreach charge-control are restored?

Is economic leverage actually comfortable once IFRS-16 leases (Yahoo FY26 total debt 22,720m, capital-lease obligations 4,184m, net debt 18,300m, cash and equivalents only 236m), net interest −1,082m, and the BTPS deficit (non-current pension 4,379m, up from 4,230m) are stacked against gilt-yield refinancing headlines — and why did leverage_override, fcf_definition_divergence and interim_quality_overlay stay false on a regulated telecom with empty Yahoo quarterlies and no intra-year statutory?

How do the 29 Jun 2026 BT–Verizon international JV, Bharti Airtel stake-building (Jul 2026 headlines), the 28 May UK-government block of a major shareholder move, and any remaining EE/Global/Openreach perimeter change the earnings, FCF and national-security ownership bases the screen is using? Are cheapness / FCF Yield / Earnings Quality still computed on a pre-JV, fully consolidated international book?

Statutory FY26 NI is 1,077m after unusual items of about −771m/−803m (restructuring 336m, write-offs, impairments) versus normalized income 1,711m and operating income 3,531m. Earnings Quality and Piotroski passed; ROE is 8.5% on 12,564m equity but tangible book is only 596m. Which earnings and book bases does P/E 18.5 / P/B 1.6 use, and how much of ‘quality’ is depreciation-heavy Openreach asset mix versus cash conversion?

Screen trade_plan is null while summary cites core/tactical limits £197.50 / £193.14 (stop £181.42, target £213.47) against a BT-A quote conventionally in pence. With RSI 53, price only +1.5% versus the 200-day, 5 weeks persistent Buy since 2026-08-16, conviction_score 1.0 versus summary ‘Conviction 67%’, and research already at Accumulate / high / adjusted_signal buy, is the ladder buying a post-fibre-peak name on a pounds-versus-pence limit stack and a currency-mislabeled ‘$1861M’ FCF?

meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags and intra-year coverage are true. For BT-A.L they are not: period_coverage annual=8/interim=0/trading_update=1 is eight Companies House group accounts (2019–2026) plus one mis-tagged ‘Across The Markets’ wrap, while the live 22 Jul 2026 REG Trading Statement and 29 Jun Verizon JV exist only as news headlines. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps. Headline-only news therefore carries the only post-FY26 operating prints, ranked below empty quarterlies.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force one (or two) CH annual bodies + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for a later-ingested Q1 TU, the Verizon JV RNS, or FY26 prelim slides. There is no tagged interim, so a second summarize_filing_body cannot be an H1 without inventing a source; assigning the catalogued trading_update would make a worker summarise a Hollywood Bowl/Castings aggregator. No task type exists to reconcile filing/Yahoo 1,861m versus screen TTM 1,200.4m FCF, Openreach versus EE/Consumer versus Global/JV perimeter, or lease-plus-pension economic leverage.

The screen still emits buy (6/22, 5/5 families including FCF Yield at 9.3% and Neff PEGY at 0.05 despite growth −9.0%) while failed_models is [] despite 16/22 non-passes, TTM cashflow is suppressed, and fcf_definition_divergence / leverage_override / interim_quality_overlay stay false on a two-way FCF split, £18.3bn net debt and a £4.4bn pension deficit. Research overlays already cut to Accumulate / high / 0.68, and action_note repeats that paragraph many times, so the trial is asked to re-verify a headline Buy the overlay has already downgraded.

A 5-week persistent buy since 2026-08-16 with a news-only July trading statement, a live Verizon JV, Bharti/NSI ownership headlines, gilt-refinancing risk, and no H1 FY27 statutory as of 4 Sep (typical BT November window) has no watch schema (ingest of the 22 Jul TU / next H1, JV close and remaining international earnings, Openreach build vs harvest / Ofcom charge-control, pension/gilt refinancing, remaining buyback vs TVR). conviction_score 1.0 versus summary ‘Conviction 67%’ and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend Openreach wholesale, EE/Consumer, Global/JV and BTPS and will not force SEGMENT / PERIMETER (Openreach vs EE vs Global vs Verizon JV), FCF-DEFINITION (Yahoo/filing 1,861m vs screen TTM 1,200.4m), LEASE-PLUS-PENSION vs EX-LEASE NET DEBT, FIBRE-CYCLE (peak build vs harvest), CAPITAL RETURNS (4.0% dividend vs cash buybacks), OWNERSHIP/NSI, or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box for the missing July TU and JV RNS. Without those slots workers will treat Kalkine fibre/competition SEO as colour and Yahoo 1,861m FCF as equivalent to screen TTM 1,200m.
